cases.explain: Моисей is the indirect object of сказал (said to whom), which takes the dative case.

cases.sentence: Рука Господа поразит страшным ___ твой скот.
cases.translation: The hand of Yahweh will strike your livestock with a terrible pestilence.
cases.explain: The means of the action (strike with what) is expressed in the instrumental case.

cases.translation: They took ashes from the furnace.
cases.explain: зола is the direct object of взяли; feminine nouns in -а end in -у in the accusative.

cases.sentence: Какого Египет не знал со времен своего ___.
cases.translation: …such as Egypt had not known since its founding.
cases.explain: The phrase со времён (since the time of) governs the genitive case.
The preposition в with direction takes the accusative; feminine nouns in -я end in -ю in the accusative.

cases.translation: There had been no such storm in Egypt.
cases.explain: The preposition в indicating location takes the prepositional case.

cases.translation: Moses raised his staff toward the sky.
cases.explain: посох is the direct object of поднял; an inanimate masculine noun has accusative equal to nominative.

cases.translation: Moses raised his staff toward the sky.
cases.explain: The preposition к (toward) always governs the dative case.

reading.ru: Весь скот египтян пал, но у израилетян не пало ни одно животное.
reading.question: What happened to the livestock in the plague?
options: All Egypt's livestock died but Israel's did not
reading.correct: All Egypt's livestock died but Israel's did not
reading.explain: The text says all the livestock of the Egyptians died, but not one animal of the Israelites.

reading.ru: Чародеи не смогли появиться перед Моисеем из-за нарывов, которые появились на них и на всех египтянах.
reading.question: Why couldn't the magicians stand before Moses?
options: Because of the boils on them
reading.correct: Because of the boils on them
reading.explain: The text says the magicians could not appear before Moses because of the boils that broke out on them.

reading.ru: Только в земле Гошен, где жили израилетяне, града не было.
reading.question: Where was there no hail?
reading.explain: The text says only in the land of Goshen, where the Israelites lived, there was no hail.

reading.ru: На этот раз я согрешил, сказал он им.
reading.question: What did Pharaoh admit this time?
reading.explain: Pharaoh confesses, 'This time I have sinned.'

reading.ru: Лен и ячмень погибли, потому что в ту пору ячмень колосился, а лен свел, а пшеница и полба не погибли, они созревают позже.
reading.question: Which crops were destroyed and which survived?
options: Flax and barley were destroyed, wheat and spelt survived
reading.correct: Flax and barley were destroyed, wheat and spelt survived
reading.explain: The text says the flax and barley were struck, but the wheat and spelt were not, because they ripen later.

reading.ru: Сердце фараона исполнилось упрямством, и он не отпустил израилетян, как Господь и говорил через Моисея.
reading.question: What was Pharaoh's final response?
options: His heart hardened and he did not release the Israelites
reading.correct: His heart hardened and he did not release the Israelites
reading.explain: The text says Pharaoh's heart was filled with stubbornness and he did not let the Israelites go.
